name: Apple Inc.
description: Designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories, and sells a variety of related services.
moat: Ecosystem lock-in, proprietary silicon, brand loyalty, and massive recurring high-margin services revenue.
invalidation_criteria: Sustained decline in active device installed base, loss of app store commission structure, or failure in edge AI monetization.
latest_catalyst: Apple Intelligence global rollout and iPhone upgrade supercycle.

name: Airbnb, Inc.
description: Operates a global two-sided online marketplace platform connecting hosts offering unique stays and experiences with guests worldwide.

invalidation_criteria: Sustained deceleration of Gross Booking Value (GBV) below 8% YoY or municipal regulatory bans severely shrinking active listings in top 50 markets.
latest_catalyst: Expansion into co-hosting marketplace and international emerging travel markets.

invalidation_criteria: Disruption of creative subscription base by generative AI startups or consecutive quarters of net new ARR deceleration.

name: Analog Devices, Inc.
description: Designs and manufactures high-performance analog, mixed-signal, and digital signal processing integrated circuits.
moat: Deep engineering patent portfolio, high switching costs in automotive battery management systems (BMS) and aerospace/defense electronics.
invalidation_criteria: Prolonged inventory digestion in European automotive and factory automation sectors.
latest_catalyst: Industrial IoT automation recovery, wireless BMS adoption in new EV platforms.

name: Automatic Data Processing, Inc.
description: Provides cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions including payroll, talent management, HR, benefits administration, and compliance.
moat: Extremely high client retention (>92%), client fund float interest earnings ($35B+ average client balance), mission-critical payroll compliance.
invalidation_criteria: Major recession causing severe white-collar corporate employment contraction.

invalidation_criteria: Deceleration in AEC software billings or macroeconomic freeze in commercial construction.

invalidation_criteria: Safety issues or delayed regulatory approval for vutrisiran in ATTR-CM indication.

latest_catalyst: Medical loss ratio stabilization, OptumHealth clinic expansion, and Medicare Advantage rate adjustments.

name: Visa Inc.
description: World's largest retail electronic payments network, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities.
moat: Unassailable global payments network effect (>4.3B cards issued), 67%+ operating margin, extraordinary free cash flow conversion, and pricing power.
invalidation_criteria: DOJ antitrust litigation forcing card routing concessions or mandated interchange fee reductions.
latest_catalyst: Value-added services revenue growth (Visa Direct, risk & security solutions) and cross-border payment expansion.

name: Verisk Analytics, Inc.
description: Provides data analytics, risk assessment, and predictive underwriting tools to the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry.
moat: Monopoly database of historical insurance actuarial claims in the US, essential rating software embedded into insurer workflows, >80% recurring revenue.
invalidation_criteria: Regulatory scrutiny on proprietary insurance rate database pricing.
latest_catalyst: Catastrophe modeling software demand and insurance claims automation tools.

name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated
description: Discovers and develops transformative medicines for serious diseases including cystic fibrosis (Trikafta), sickle cell (CASGEVY), and acute pain (Suzetrigine).
moat: Cystic fibrosis monopoly (>90% market share), non-opioid acute/neuropathic pain franchise (Suzetrigine), $10B+ net cash balance sheet.
invalidation_criteria: FDA approval rejection or clinical safety issues in suzetrigine pain franchise.
latest_catalyst: Suzetrigine FDA approval in moderate-to-severe acute pain and CASGEVY commercial ramp.

name: Verizon Communications Inc.
description: Provides communications, technology, information and entertainment products and services to consumers, businesses and government entities.
moat: Extensive 5G wireless network and fiber infrastructure; however, burdened by massive debt load ($125B+), high capital intensity, and intense pricing competition from T-Mobile.
invalidation_criteria: Postpaid phone subscriber losses or dividend coverage strain from heavy spectrum and debt servicing costs.
latest_catalyst: Fixed wireless access (5G Home) broadband growth and Frontier fiber acquisition.

name: Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.
description: Premier global media and entertainment company offering content across television, film, streaming (Max), and gaming (HBO, Warner Bros, DC).
moat: Legendary content IP vault (Harry Potter, DC Comics, HBO, Lord of the Rings), global streaming subscriber ramp.
invalidation_criteria: Debt load sustainability concerns or accelerated linear TV advertising decline.
latest_catalyst: Max global rollout, rapid net debt reduction, and DTC streaming EBITDA growth.

name: Workday, Inc.
description: Provides cloud enterprise software for human capital management (HCM), financial management, and analytics to the world's largest corporations.
moat: Over 50% of the Fortune 500 rely on Workday for mission-critical core HR and financial planning, >95% customer retention, expanding operating margins.
invalidation_criteria: Deceleration of 12-month subscription revenue backlog below 12%.
latest_catalyst: Workday Illuminate AI platform integration and enterprise Financials suite adoption.

name: Western Digital Corporation
description: Develops, manufactures, and sells data storage devices including hard disk drives (ePMR/UltraSMR HDDs) and solid-state drives (Flash/NAND).
moat: Duopoly in nearline mass-capacity enterprise HDDs (with Seagate), UltraSMR capacity density leadership for cloud hyperscaler storage.
invalidation_criteria: Severe cloud storage capex pause or execution friction in planned corporate separation into Flash and HDD standalone entities.
latest_catalyst: Spin-off separation of Flash business to unlock pure-play market valuations.

name: Walmart Inc.
description: Engages in retail and wholesale operations, operating grocery and merchandise stores, hypermarkets, and e-commerce platforms across the US and international markets.
moat: Unmatched physical store proximity (within 10 miles of 90% of US population), massive grocery purchasing power, fast-growing high-margin retail media advertising (Walmart Connect), and automation.
invalidation_criteria: Operating margin compression below 3.5% or severe loss of market share in grocery to discounters.
latest_catalyst: Supply chain automated fulfillment center rollout and Walmart Connect advertising high-margin profit growth.

name: Xcel Energy Inc.
description: Regulated electric and natural gas delivery company serving 3.7 million electricity and 2.1 million natural gas customers across eight Western and Midwestern states.
moat: Regulated monopoly service territories, high rate-base growth supporting renewable energy transition and data center power demand.
invalidation_criteria: Catastrophic wildfire liability exceeding insurance reserves.
latest_catalyst: Clean energy transmission infrastructure expansion and data center load additions.

name: Block, Inc. (Square / Cash App)
description: Builds economic tools for commerce (Square seller ecosystem) and financial services for individuals (Cash App, Afterpay BNPL).
moat: Two-sided Cash App and Square seller ecosystem; offset by volatile Bitcoin trading revenue reliance, intense fintech competition, and regulatory compliance headwinds.
invalidation_criteria: Deceleration in Cash App gross profit growth below 10% or federal regulatory actions regarding Cash App compliance.
latest_catalyst: Rule of 40 operational discipline and Square seller distribution integration.

name: Zoom Video Communications, Inc.
description: Provides a unified communications and collaboration platform including Zoom Meetings, Zoom Phone, Zoom Team Chat, and Contact Center.
moat: Frictionless video conferencing brand; however, growth has decelerated to low single digits due to fierce competition from Microsoft Teams bundled with Office 365.
invalidation_criteria: Enterprise customer net expansion rate falling below 98% or ongoing margin compression in AI contact centers.
latest_catalyst: Zoom AI Companion adoption and Zoom Contact Center enterprise wins.

name: Zscaler, Inc.
description: Cloud security company providing the Zero Trust Exchange platform that securely connects users, applications, and devices over any network.
moat: Pioneering distributed cloud proxy security architecture (150+ data centers globally), high enterprise switching costs, Zero Trust standard.
invalidation_criteria: Deceleration in annual recurring revenue growth below 18% or margin compression.
latest_catalyst: Zero Trust SASE and AI security operations product suite adoption.
